proxy.comment: MAX_FEATURES limit exists for memory pre-allocation. Currently ~113 features in use, well below the 200 limit.

generator.comment: Feature file is regenerated every 5 minutes from a randomly selected database shard.

database.comment: Distributed tables in 'default' database. Underlying shard data in 'r0' database. Metadata queries go through system_columns.

deployment.comment: Feature files are propagated immediately to all edge nodes for rapid bot threat response.
